samples.evidence: The data presented here are part of a multi-centric qualitative investigation which brings together quantitative and qualitative data on 57 cases of elderly people, among 87 interviewed in 14 municipalities in five regions of Brazil. The empirical categories that emerged from the speeches and stories of the people interviewed (men and women) who attempted suicide or had persistent suicidal ideation are now presented – the categories that emerged from the empirical data, and are subject to superimposition and many other interactions, since this is a complex subject – are: (1) the 'nowhere' situation of the subject; (2) non-acceptance of losses; (3) suffering due to ungratefulness of family members; (4) a sense of existential uselessness; and (5) re-signification of the situations that generate the suicide-related conduct.
